name: Class D Permit (Employment)

requirements.blocker_text: Must be offered specific employment by a specific Kenyan employer, possess skills or qualifications unavailable locally, and the employment must benefit Kenya.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a specific job offer from a Kenyan employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must provide evidence of unsuccessful local recruitment efforts and identify a Kenyan understudy (with certified qualifications) for the role.
Employer (and, on renewal, the individual) must hold a valid Tax Compliance Certificate.

evidence_required.document: Employer cover letter to the Director General

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build; issued annually based on the fee structure (KSh 500,000/year issuance fee)

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services, Republic of Kenya -- Class D (Employment) Permit: requires a specific employer offer, unavailable-locally skills, evidence of unsuccessful local recruitment, a named Kenyan understudy with certified qualifications, employer and (on renewal) individual Tax Compliance Certificates; processing fee KSh 20,000 (non-refundable), issuance fee KSh 500,000/year, gratis for East African Community member-state nationals; applied for via the eFNS portal

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kenya). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Directorate of Immigration Services). DISTINCTIVE STRUCTURAL FEATURE: the mandatory 'Kenyan understudy' requirement -- the employer must name a specific Kenyan employee being groomed to eventually replace the foreign worker, with certified qualifications submitted as part of the application. This is a formalized skills-transfer/localization mechanism not seen elsewhere in this dataset in this explicit a form. Notably steep annual issuance fee (KSh 500,000, roughly several thousand USD) relative to many other countries' work-permit fees built in this dataset, waived entirely for East African Community (EAC) nationals -- a real, tier-1-confirmed regional preference. Duration was not specified in the source beyond the annual fee cadence; disclosed as a gap.
